searchMap.placeholder.en: Search topics, activities, clubs and shops
searchMap.placeholder.zh-Hans: 搜索主题、活动、俱乐部和商家

searchMap.partialSignIn.en: Sign in to include results from restricted sources
searchMap.partialSignIn.zh-Hans: 登录后可查看需要登录的搜索来源

searchMap.partialFailure.en: Some sources could not be refreshed
searchMap.partialFailure.zh-Hans: 部分搜索来源未能更新

searchMap.allFailed.en: None of the sources could be loaded
searchMap.allFailed.zh-Hans: 所有搜索来源均未能加载

searchMap.emptyHint.en: Try another keyword or adjust the filters
searchMap.emptyHint.zh-Hans: 换个关键词或调整筛选条件

searchMap.pageLimit.en: Shows the first 12 topics and activities from each source. Club and shop lists follow their source results.
searchMap.pageLimit.zh-Hans: 主题和活动各展示来源的前 12 条，俱乐部和商家按来源结果展示

searchMap.invalidInput.en: Check the category, dates and price range
searchMap.invalidInput.zh-Hans: 请检查分类、日期和价格范围

searchMap.dateFormat.en: Use YYYY-MM-DD. Leave a field empty for no limit.
searchMap.dateFormat.zh-Hans: 使用 YYYY-MM-DD 格式，留空表示不限

searchMap.clientFilters.en: Date and price filters apply locally to loaded topics and activities. Missing dates or prices stay visible. Clubs and shops are unchanged. The source price unit is not converted.
searchMap.clientFilters.zh-Hans: 日期和价格仅在本地筛选已加载的主题及活动，缺失日期或价格的结果仍保留。俱乐部和商家不受影响，来源价格单位不做换算

searchMap.manualDisclosure.en: Choose a manual search center, then search. Only that center is sent to the configured service for this request. No device location is captured or saved.
searchMap.manualDisclosure.zh-Hans: 选择手动搜索中心后再搜索。仅本次请求将所选中心发送至已配置的服务，不获取或保存设备位置

searchMap.appleMapDisclosure.en: Showing the map loads Apple map tiles for the selected area. Your current location is not requested.
searchMap.appleMapDisclosure.zh-Hans: 显示地图会加载所选区域的 Apple 地图，不请求当前位置

searchMap.offlineMap.en: Synthetic map preview; no map provider is contacted
searchMap.offlineMap.zh-Hans: 合成地图预览，不连接地图服务

searchMap.layerFailed.en: This map layer could not be updated

searchMap.listOnly.en: Activities shown only in the list

searchMap.cityRateLimited.en: City lookup is busy. Choose a search center manually or retry later.
searchMap.cityRateLimited.zh-Hans: 城市查询繁忙，请手动选择搜索中心或稍后重试

searchMap.cityManual.en: City lookup is unavailable. Use the manual search center.
searchMap.cityManual.zh-Hans: 城市查询暂不可用，请使用手动搜索中心

searchMap.routeNodeDomain.en: This is a route stop. Its node ID is not a city POI ID.
searchMap.routeNodeDomain.zh-Hans: 这是路线站点，其节点编号不等于城市地点编号

searchMap.templateDomain.en: The template name is a reference; it is not a topic-detail link.
searchMap.templateDomain.zh-Hans: 模板名称仅供参考，不对应主题详情链接

searchMap.nodeReadOnly.en: Read-only node information. Check-in, validation and favorite changes are separate flows.
searchMap.nodeReadOnly.zh-Hans: 此处仅展示节点信息，打卡、验证和收藏修改需使用对应流程

searchMap.routeOriginDisclosure.en: The origin is your selected search center, not your current position.
searchMap.routeOriginDisclosure.zh-Hans: 起点是所选搜索中心，并非当前位置

searchMap.roadRoute.zh-Hans: 已提供的道路路线预览

searchMap.straightLineNotice.en: The dashed line is a geographic preview, not a walkable or drivable route. Travel time and turn instructions are unavailable.
searchMap.straightLineNotice.zh-Hans: 虚线仅为地理连线，并非可步行或驾车的道路路线，暂无用时或转弯指引

searchMap.transitNotice.en: Transit transfers and step-by-step guidance are not available here.
searchMap.transitNotice.zh-Hans: 此处暂不提供公交换乘及分步指引

searchMap.routeBoundary.en: Live route planning, device tracking and external navigation are not enabled in this migration slice.
searchMap.routeBoundary.zh-Hans: 本阶段未启用实时道路规划、设备位置跟踪及外部导航

searchMap.routeFailed.en: The supplied route could not be loaded
searchMap.routeFailed.zh-Hans: 未能加载所提供的路线

searchMap.historyUnavailable.en: Recent-search storage is unavailable. This session can still search.
searchMap.historyUnavailable.zh-Hans: 最近搜索存储暂不可用，本次会话仍可继续搜索
